translations.web: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.
translations.bsb: you must drive out before you all the inhabitants of the land, destroy all their carved images and cast idols, and demolish all their high places.
translations.kjv: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
